errors.text_span: Mittelwert (hellblau, durchgezogen), Maximum (dunkelblau, durchgezogen) und Minimum (grau, durchgezogen)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color of the 'Minimum' line as 'grau' (grey) when it is light blue. It also describes the 'Mittelwert' (mean) line as 'hellblau' (light blue), which is ambiguous as the 'Minimum' line is the lightest blue. The legend shows three shades of blue for the three lines.
The description states that the 'Mittelwert' (mean value) line reaches 10,000 MW at a bonus amount of 0.5 Eurocent/kWh. However, the graph clearly shows this value is reached at 0.4 Eurocent/kWh.
